title: BotDeal product observation
description: One product offer observed by the BotDeal deal-hunting stack. Written as one Parquet row per (url, observed_at) in Database/<Month>/DAY<d>/.

unique_id.description: Stable series key, e.g. 'rtx-5090' (br_hardware catalog id).

name.description: Offer title as shown by the source.

price.description: Null when the hit carries no parsed price yet.

source.description: Hostname the offer came from, e.g. 'lista.mercadolivre.com.br'.

snippet.description: Raw hit snippet kept for evidence re-parsing.

query.description: The dork/search query that produced this hit.
